failed.evidence: Most of the goal holds: the accepted shadow appears in MCP list rows and in release details (index.ts:165, projection.ts:700) and in the detail header (ReleaseDetail.tsx:284). The ['releases'] key is invalidated by create/update (useReleases.ts:201,223), push (useReleasePushes.ts:38), accept together with git-shadows and shadow-diff (useReleases.ts:162-166), and file:changed in the releases root (useFileWatcher.ts:90). The missing part is 'open tabs learn about new and edited releases and about shadow acceptance through M49 events'. Nothing emits that event: every in-app release-file write goes through ReleaseFileStore.write → records.writeSync (release-store.ts:162). That covers createRelease, updateRelease and the acceptance variant (release.ts:699). writeSync runs record-store steps 1-4 with no chain, and the watcher event is suppressed, so the notification phase (fs/notifications.ts:37) never broadcasts file:changed { rootId: 'releases' }. Meanwhile release:created/release:updated reach only ['release-diff'] (release-diff-invalidation.ts:41), and useReleases.list-key.test.ts:131 asserts they do not refetch the list. Result: a release created or edited by the agent (MCP release_create/release_update), from another tab, or by acceptance in another tab never refreshes ['releases'] in open tabs. useReleases.list-key.test.ts injects file:changed on the client and never proves the server emits it.
